reason: A web browsing plugin that fetches HTTP/HTTPS pages, extracts readable Markdown or plain text, and provides a bounded link inventory; the README describes read-only operation without credential handling.

summaries.zh: 用于抓取 HTTP/HTTPS 网页并提取 Markdown 或纯文本正文，同时可整理页面中的链接清单。
summaries.en: Fetches HTTP/HTTPS webpages, extracts readable Markdown or plain text, and optionally provides a link inventory.

capabilities: Fetches content from supplied HTTP and HTTPS URLs
Extracts webpage content as Markdown or plain text
Enumerates and resolves links found on webpages
